explanation: Single-point EXCLURAD input for ep -> e'p eta at W=1.6 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos(theta*)=0.5, phi*=90 deg, using the eta-channel (EtaMAID) configuration and standard CLAS12 settings documented in README.md/examples: model=3 (maid2000/EtaMAID), rc_mode=0 (full O(alpha) correction), bmom=6.53 GeV, tmom=0.0 (fixed target), lepton=1 (electron), ivec=1 (detected recoil proton), vcut=0.166 GeV^2 (CLAS12 inelasticity cut). Kinematics were checked for physical validity: W=1.6 GeV is above the p-eta threshold (m_p+m_eta=1.486 GeV) and within the EtaMAID-2023 table range (W: 1.4856-6 GeV, Q2: 0-5 GeV^2 per mpintp.inc); at bmom=6.53 GeV this Q2,W point implies a scattered-electron energy of ~5.10 GeV and scattering angle ~10 degrees, both kinematically allowed. No corrections were needed; the file follows the exact input.dat/examples format (including the required trailing NAG-artifact line) and is ready to run as `./build/exclurad.exe < input_eta_W1.60_Q2_1.00_cos0.50_phi90.dat` once the code is compiled, producing radcor.dat/radtot.dat etc. with the delta = sigma_obs/sigma_0 radiative correction for this point.
